item.title: Blake Lively, Justin Baldoni head to court in NY for settlement conference
item.description: NEW YORK — It could end with mediation, as “It Ends With Us” co-stars Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni are in a New York courtroom Wednesday for their court-ordered settlement conference.

item.title: Washougal woman pleads not guilty to animal cruelty charges
item.description: A Washougal woman entered not-guilty pleas Wednesday to nearly two dozen animal cruelty charges after authorities say they found dying horses and cats living in squalor on her property.

item.title: PeaceHealth to lay off 94 employees statewide, including 46 in Clark County
item.description: Vancouver-based PeaceHealth will lay off 94 employees statewide, 46 of them in Clark County, by April 12.

item.title: Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez joins other Democrats to vote against SAVE America Act
item.description: Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, D-Skamania, joined all but one Democrat on Wednesday in voting against the Republicans’ latest version of the election reform legislation known as the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility, or SAVE, America Act.

item.title: Clark County council debates resolution condemning ICE enforcement in front of packed room
item.description: Supporters and opponents of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdowns once again filled the Clark County Council hearing room Wednesday as the council continued to debate whether to release a statement on the issue.

item.title: Paisley Henderson of Mountain View bowling is The Columbian 2025-26 Week 15 prep athlete of the week sponsored by Killer Burger
item.description: Paisley Henderson of Mountain View bowling is The Columbian 2025-26 Week 15 high school athlete of the week, sponsored by Killer Burger. She received 300 of the 748 votes cast last week to win the honor.

item.title: Turnovers and too much Julius Randle doom Blazers in 133-109 loss to Timberwolves
item.description: Julius Randle had 41 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat Portland 133-109 on Wednesday night to end the Trail Blazers' winning streak at three.

item.title: Prep Basketball Roundup: Jenna Klopman scores 26 points as Washougal wins district play-in game
item.description: Jenna Klopman scored 26 points to lead Washougal to a 60-39 win over Centralia in a Class 2A District 4 tournament play-in game on Wednesday.
